Cup MOQ Explained: How to Start Small With Custom Cups

Article Quick Facts

Custom-print MOQ
From 1,000 pcs per size
Counted by
Each printed size
Stock cups
Smaller trial quantities possible
Lean tactic
Fewer sizes, shared caliber

What MOQ Means and Why It Exists

MOQ (minimum order quantity) is the smallest run a factory will produce for a given item. For custom-printed cups it exists because printing setup — plates, tooling and machine time — has a fixed cost that only makes sense above a certain volume. Understanding how MOQ is counted lets a small brand plan an affordable first order.

How to Plan a Lean First Order

Tactics to keep a first custom order small without breaking the MOQ math.

TacticHowBenefit
Limit sizesLaunch 1-2 core sizesFewer MOQ multiples to hit
Share a caliberPick sizes on one rim (e.g. 95mm)One lid, less inventory
Print the filmBrand via sealing filmOne roll covers all sizes
Start with stockPlain cups + printed filmLower entry volume
Scale laterAdd sizes as demand proves outCash-flow friendly

The 1,000 pcs Custom-Print MOQ

Custom logo printing starts at 1,000 pieces per size. If you launch a single 16oz cup, that is one MOQ unit; add a 22oz and you have two. This is why size discipline matters early on — a two-size menu keeps a branded launch at a manageable 2,000 pieces total rather than spreading thin across five sizes.

A Lean Path for New Brands

New brands can start with plain stock cups paired with custom-printed sealing film. Because one film roll brands every cup size at once, you get a branded look at a lower entry volume, then move to fully printed cups once your best-selling sizes are proven. This keeps the first order affordable while still looking professional.

Article FAQs

What is the MOQ for custom printed cups?

Custom logo printing starts at 1,000 pieces per size. Each printed size counts toward the MOQ, so launching fewer sizes keeps the total order smaller.

Can a small brand order below the MOQ?

For fully custom-printed cups the 1,000 pcs-per-size minimum applies. A lean alternative is plain stock cups with custom-printed film, which can start at a lower volume.

How do I keep my first order affordable?

Limit yourself to one or two core sizes on a shared caliber, and consider branding through printed sealing film so one roll covers every size.
